$comment: The error.code enum is generated from client-table.json by scripts/generate_schemas.py; do not edit it by hand.
title: Agentfleet client error envelope
description: The envelope-shaped document agentfleet prints for its own failures (unknown instance, duplicate instance, Docker unavailable, malformed producer stdout, usage). Spec section 4 exit classes apply; error.code lives in the client. namespace (see client-table.json).

contract.description: The contract major.minor the client speaks, e.g. 1.0.

message.description: Human-readable cause; consumers must not parse it.

retryable.description: Whether retrying the same operation may help.

details.description: Code-specific fields; consumers must ignore unknown keys.
